column7: Decides whether the /mcp intake refuses a keyed tools/call with an id from a caller with no execution principal (-32003), reading the owner and caller key admission reads; a task submit on a gateway with authentication off is left to the task path (MIK-8382 ruling B), so a mistake would pool or refuse the wrong callers
Records the /mcp intake refusal as invalid, as the direct route records it, and answers -32003 with HTTP 400 and the request id; a mistake would drop the record or change the answer (MIK-8382)
Writes the invalid audit record of an intake refusal for the target as the request spells it, then answers HTTP 400; a request with no usable id is still recorded and answered with no id (MIK-8382)
